name: yolo26n-cls
what_it_classifies: Cosmetic grade tier (3A/3B/4/5) of an intact tile. This model does NOT detect cracks or broken corners - that is camera_node's classical CV path (crack_detection.py / corner_detection.py). Trained on 376 photos of intact tiles; see camera_models/cam_edge/README.md before trusting any single prediction.
